user_query: I'm planning a hiking trip to a national park. I want to stay informed about any recent news related to climate change and its impact on the environment. Can you provide me with all the news about climate change from around the world? It would be great if I can get the news in multiple languages to share with other hikers I meet on the trail.

TaskList.description: Fetch recent news articles related to climate change from global news sources.
Translate the fetched news articles into multiple languages.
Compile the translated news articles into a format suitable for sharing with other hikers.
